Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.440.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '9bc5461bcdea9e2ff40b97c59fd6a54bca1eccaf8d4243228662b09fac9c42f5') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.440.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '20d94d3ea3a35eeeee905f1e99fbb9fc784922a140ec00f2a53f79a335250871') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
